VAL_CONF_confirmation_rule: Only the single VAL-DEV-selected checkpoint may be evaluated on VAL-CONF. It must pass ALL existing B2 guards on ALL THREE VAL-CONF sampling seeds (3/3). No re-selection, no alternate checkpoint, and no threshold relaxation.
VAL_DEV_robust_eligibility_rule: A checkpoint is robust-eligible only if it passes ALL existing B2 guards on ALL THREE VAL-DEV sampling seeds (3/3).
VAL_DEV_selection_rule: Among robust-eligible E1-E5 checkpoints, select the checkpoint with lowest MEAN full 1-40 Hz PSD MAE across the three VAL-DEV sampling seeds. Tie -> lower mean bandpower MAE -> lower mean alpha-effect MAE -> earlier epoch. If no robust-eligible checkpoint exists, that training run fails and VAL-CONF is not accessed for that run.
cross_training_seed_replication_rule: Both predeclared fresh training runs PRIMARY and REPLICATION must independently yield a VAL-DEV robust-selected checkpoint that passes all three VAL-CONF seeds.
formal_freeze_candidate_if_successful: The predeclared PRIMARY run's selected checkpoint becomes the sole formal B2 freeze candidate. REPLICATION confirms the selector mechanism and is not allowed to replace PRIMARY.
reason_for_change: s2_68 showed that the nearest failed fresh checkpoint missed only EO parent-relative scale at point ratio 0.88985912 versus lower guard 0.90, but subject bootstrap did not justify retroactive acceptance. Therefore the final family explicitly requires sampling-seed robustness rather than changing thresholds.

sampling_seeds.important: Seed 20261511 on VAL-DEV and seed 20261512 on VAL-CONF reuse the already-locked s2_66 Frozen-B1 baselines. The remaining four seeds are new and frozen before any s2_70 continuation training.

scientific_role: Final continuation-B2 selector family after s2_67 single-sampling-seed replication failure.
seedwise_guard_rule: For every candidate checkpoint and every sampling seed, apply the unchanged existing B2 eligibility helper relative to the Frozen-B1 baseline generated with the SAME cohort and the SAME sampling seed. No threshold changes.
terminal_failure_rule: If either fresh training run fails VAL-DEV robust selection or 3/3 VAL-CONF confirmation, continuation-B2 is CLOSED. No additional rescue selector, threshold change, epoch sweep, or training-seed replacement is allowed. Frozen B1 remains the robust generator for downstream utility.
